verdict.rationale: Copilot's docs say cloud and local sandboxes give isolated execution environments. In them, Copilot can safely work with code, tools, filesystem and network resources on your machine or in fully isolated cloud environments. The cloud agent runs these tasks in the background. This covers the core of testing in a sandbox, but the claim rests on a single doc statement. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that sandboxes are separated from production data or credentials, detail on how testing works inside the sandbox, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
